question: During depletion, the oil phase volume fell from 60.19 mL at 29 MPa to 41.35 mL at 20 MPa. By what percentage did it shrink?
rendered:
To find the percentage by which the oil phase volume shrank, we use the formula:

((Initial Volume - Final Volume) / Initial Volume) × 100%

Initial Volume = 60.19 mL
Final Volume = 41.35 mL

((60.19 - 41.35) / 60.19) × 100% ≈ (18.84 / 60.19) × 100% ≈ 0.313 or 31.3%

So, the oil phase volume shrank by approximately 31.3% during depletion.
